run_train_and_evaluate: run the MD4 training pipeline with a config file and work directory for non-sharded training
run_sharded_train_and_evaluate: run the MD4 sharded training pipeline across multiple JAX devices with a config file and work directory
create_train_state: create and initialize the MD4 model train state with config, rng, input shape, and schedule function
create_checkpoint_manager: create an Orbax checkpoint manager for saving and restoring MD4 train state and data iterators
run_sampling_generate: run MD4 model sampling to generate text or image samples from the trained model
